To

All Addl. Central P.F. Commissioners (Zones)
Subject : Verification of Closed Exempted/Relaxed Establishments - Regarding.

Reference : Head Office letter No. C-Ex/32(1)/15/BR/SRO/MUZ/CE/EZ/10249 Dated : 05.09.2016
(available on the official website of EPFO at SI. No. 344 under Office Orders /Circulars link) .

Sir,

Please refer to the subject and reference cited above. A reference had been received from a field office
seeking approval of Head Office for taking over of Trust fund of an exempted establishment reported to be lying
closed for more than 14 years. The establishment was also reported to have undergone merger/acquisition in the
past. The Trust had been running illegally all these years.

2. Funds lying with a private Provident Fund Trust where the establishment which was granted exemption/
relaxation, but is lying closed since long and the Trust is running illegally cannot be said to be safe and in the
interests of the employees. Neither it is the intention of the legislation behind grant of exemption to the
establishments. Such Trust funds is also vulnerable to potential frauds. It was felt imperative and desirable that In the
overall interest of the workers and the public, accumulations of the members lying in such private Provident Fund
Trusts is transferred to the statutory fund alongwith past accumulation statement following due procedure laid down
for transfer of Trust funds.

3 it was in this background that RPFCs of the field offices were directed to take stock of the situation in their ~
respective jurisdictions and initiate suitable action if any such case came to their notice. Further, RPFCs/OICs of the
field offices were required to furnish an action taken report in this regard latest by 30.09.2016.

4. n this regard, it is observed that so far 20 out of 122 field offices have responded to the instructions
contained in the Head Office circular under reference. Out of these 20 field offices, 12 ROs/SROs have furnished ‘Nil’
report, whereas 08 ROs/SROs out of these 20 field offices, have furnished report in respect of certain establishments
which is not in accordance with the requirements of the Head Office instructions and needs to be revisited. In view of
inadequate response of the field offices, Addl. CPFC(Zones) are requested to guide and sensitize the RPFCs/OICs
of the field offices to accord due priority to the task and to arrange to furnish the requisite Action Taken Report by
15.01.2017. It is further clarified that the reports of the ROs/SROs shall be checked and consolidated at the level of
the Zonal Offices and then forwarded to the Head Office.

Yours faithfully,

ep Sts
